title: LinkedList
description:
Implement a singly `LinkedList` class with:
- `push(val)` — append a node to the tail
- `pop()` — remove and return the tail node value (or `undefined` if empty)
- `find(val)` — return the first node with matching value, or `null`
- `size` — number of nodes

**Example:**
```js
const list = new LinkedList();
list.push(1); list.push(2);
list.size; // 2
list.find(1); // { value: 1, next: ... }
list.pop(); // 2
```
ai_context: Common mistake: forgetting to decrement size in pop, or not handling the single-node edge case in pop. Also returning the node object from pop instead of the value.
